mapper.sql: select b.id, b.customer_id, b.delivery_date, b.scope_type, b.merge_same_item, b.template_id, b.layout_json, b.status, b.version, b.is_deleted, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customerName from t_delivery_batch b left join t_customer customer on customer.id = b.customer_id
mapper.insert:
insert into t_delivery_batch
customer_id, delivery_date, scope_type, merge_same_item, template_id, layout_json, status, version, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{customerId}, #{deliveryDate}, #{scopeType}, #{mergeSameItem}, #{templateId}, #{layoutJson}, #{status}, #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select: select si.sku_id as skuId, coalesce(sku.name, si.product_name) as productName, si.customer_dept_id as deptId, cd.name as deptName, sum(si.allocated_quantity) as quantity from t_delivery_source_item si join t_delivery_order o on o.id = si.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = si.sku_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = si.customer_dept_id where si.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by si.sku_id, coalesce(sku.name, si.product_name), si.customer_dept_id, cd.name order by productName, deptName

select dod.sku_id as skuId, coalesce(sku.name, dod.product_name) as productName, coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id) as deptId, cd.name as deptName, sum(dod.num) as quantity from t_delivery_order_detail dod join t_delivery_order o on o.id = dod.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = dod.sku_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id) where dod.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by dod.sku_id, coalesce(sku.name, dod.product_name), coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id), cd.name order by productName, deptName
